title: DNS: Modify dns.qry.type for using without description

notes.body: If it's hidden it can be used for filters but it's somewhat difficult to use for custom columns I think? (Can be done be entering in `dns.qry.t` directly but not by right-clicking and "Apply as Column?"

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9073/diffs?diff_id=571236622&start_sha=aceaa65b7d002846e2d91416c6b938f02302face#f15ca70cc4315e5a8d3bc1f02056bf7f464af3ec_1716_1712)
Probably makes sense to do this for `dns.resp.type` and maybe `dns.rrsig.type_covered` as well?
